digest.component_or_area: plan-review and completion-verifier workflow timing and documentation
propositions: Plan-review end-to-end duration (including overlap detection and signing) has a p50 of approximately 8.6 minutes and p90 of approximately 14.6 minutes; guidance should reflect about 15–20 minutes as user-visible expectation.

Completion-verifier-gated close end-to-end duration measured on directly instrumented runs shows p50 approximately 7.5 minutes and p90 approximately 8.8 minutes; guidance should reflect about 9–11 minutes provisionally, with small sample caveat.

Inner-workflow sidecar metrics (REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT total_ms) substantially understate user-visible wall time because they exclude pre-workflow scanning, deterministic preflight, post-sidecar overlap work, signing, and persistence phases.
Ticket-store write lock contention held a plan-review attempt for approximately 181 seconds; this is intended behavior per concurrency.md and sidecar.py design, not a defect.
